$comment: Frozen oracle for SCN-DSN-007. Pass criteria come from independent reviewers' findings files, counted by the runner, not from any header or summary an author or critic wrote about itself. Rule: .prometheus/decisions.md 2026-11-19 plus openspec/specs/agent-ui-design-workflow.
forbiddenReviewerInputs: any conversation transcript or generation log
findingMarkerRule: the runner counts lines in the file body matching ^\s*\d+\.\s+\*\*\[P0\] and ^\s*\d+\.\s+\*\*\[P1\] under the heading 'Priority Issues'; front-matter p0_count and p1_count are ignored

passRule.p1: each P1 is either absent or listed in a resolution file signed by an operator decision id

isolationCheck: the packet manifest each reviewer received lists exactly the artifact inputs above (by sha256) and no forbidden path
negativeControl: a reviewer packet manifest that includes a forbidden path invalidates that review; the runner rejects it and the review is repeated
independenceNote: the critics are agents that did not write the artifact; cross_model_check is recorded from the file front matter and reported, not used as a pass criterion
